messages:
maria: quick heads-up  opened a tiny PR to add an operational troubleshooting mini-playbook: detect a service-side "trim" signal, shorten the system prompt, and retry with backoff. want node+python snippets, a curl repro, and one-line guidance linking to the 429/timeout errref.

kevin: Can you paste the draft snippet here? ill convert to a pytest that mocks headers.

maria: draft node snippet:```javascript
// detect+retry (simplified)
const res = await fetch(RW_URL, {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)});
if (res.status === 429 || res.status === 504) {
  await retryWithBackoff(); // see SDK retry guidance link
}
const trimmed = res.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim');
if (trimmed) {
  // record metric, shorten system prompt, then retry once
  payload.system = shortenSystemPrompt(payload.system);
  await fetch(RW_URL, {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload)});
}
```

sam: looks good. small lint nit: fenced code blocks should use "javascript" (not just "js"). i'll take the node snippet through snippet-lint.

kevin: i'll do python equivalent: requests.post, check resp.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim'), and a pytest that asserts shorten->retry flow. plan to mock Response.headers to simulate the header.

liz: editorial asks: 1) add a single-bullet flowchart: detect -> shorten -> retry -> fallback (smaller model or degrade). 2) one-line on tradeoffs: prefer detect-and-shorten when you need to retain original prompt quality most of the time; proactively truncate when you must meet strict latency P95 budgets. 3) call the pattern "detect-and-shorten" (lowercase hyphenated) for cross-linking.

maria: will rename heading to "detect-and-shorten: troubleshooting pattern" and add the bullet flow. also will avoid hardcoding vendor headers and phrase it as "inspect the service metadata header (e.g. x-rw-context-trim)".

sam: also add a tiny curl repro so folks can reproduce against our local test harness. something like:```bash
# big_prompt.json contains a very long system + messages payload
curl -i -X POST "$TEST_RW_URL" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d @big_prompt.json
# expect: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# x-rw-context-trim: true
```

maria: will include that and a sample big_prompt.json fixture. planning to keep tests in a follow-up PR so this one stays small.

ci-bot: PR #702 opened by maria  labels: docs-snippet, needs-ci; reviewers requested: @sam @kevin.

ci-bot: snippet-lint failed on PR #702: code fence language must be "javascript" (found "js"); trailing whitespace detected in one codeblock.

maria: fixing fence labels and trimming whitespace now, pushing a small commit.

kevin: after the fix I'll add the pytest in a separate PR (so we don't block the copyedit). i'll prepare a tiny fixture that returns headers={'x-rw-context-trim': 'true'}.

sam: once you push the lint fixes i'll run the docs CI locally and then approve content. i'll also ensure the node example follows our minimal SDK best-practices link.

liz: editorial: include two inline links (errref for 429/timeouts; SDK retry guidance) and a one-sentence "when not to use this" note: don't use detect-and-shorten as your primary strategy for high-volume low-latency workloads
(i.e., prefer upfront prompt compacting).

maria: added the links and the "when not to" blurb. pushing again. thanks! :thumbsup:

ci-bot: snippet-lint passed for PR #702; auto-tests: snippet-lint ✅.

docs-bot: PR #702 updated  reviewers: @sam @kevin; status: ready-for-review.

sam: running a quick content pass now. small nit: change "retryWithBackoff" example to call into SDK helper so readers can point to the retry doc. otherwise LGTM.

maria: done. tagging @liz for final copyedit.

liz: quick copyedit done. the language is clear, snippets are minimal and reproducible. approving once CI stays green.

maria: thanks team, merging after green. i'll follow up with the pytest PR from kevin for additional coverage.

kevin: will open the follow-up with tests and the fixture later today.
